blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas’ defense on new naturalized player D’Angelo Harrison played a key part in Friday’s 97-58 rout in the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup Asian Qualifiers. Concerns about how Harrison would pose a potential problem for Gilas turned out to be just that as he was held to 10 points on 3-of-15 shooting in the contest held at Karisma Arena in Seremban, Malaysia.
